csv_project_name: Developer for Distributed Energy Resource Wind Microturbine
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Pasadena s (City) carbon-free goals, Pasadena Water and Power (PWP), a department of the City, is seeking a Qualified Developer (Developer) with which to collaborate in the design and procurement of a Distributed Energy Resource Wind Microturbine facility on a City-owned property (Project). The Scope Of Work (SOW) includes surveying and evaluating the municipally owned building located at 1116 Glen Avenue, Pasadena CA, 91103 (Site) for its technical feasibility to support the Project, designing, engineering, procurement of all necessary equipment and materials, completion of a Construction Bid Specification document to be used in a subsequent construction bid request, construction support and maintenance plan for the designed Project.
